dod_intent_evidence: Navy Phase II SBIR ($599,860, 2022) for real-time SLAM navigation-aiding for UUVs, interfaced to the Navy's Unmanned Maritime Autonomy Architecture (UMAA) -- own SBIR abstract.
what_they_do: Makes seafloor-mapping and underwater-vehicle navigation software (sidescan/multibeam sonar processing, SLAM navigation-aiding) sold to commercial, federal, military, and academic clients.
